selection: strict-unseen, airborne speed >30 m/s, stalest decile; three gains closest to group median
coordinates: recentered at each forecast origin; aircraft identifiers and original offsets omitted
panels: Displayed-position age over the 60 s history (right axis) and displacement error over the 30 s forecast (left axis).
age_sequences: changed_position_age_s: three 60-step histories, in the same order as the released cases; mean_age_s equals each row mean.
privacy: Only origin-relative coordinates, derived errors and ages are retained; source window indices, dates, timestamps and aircraft identifiers are omitted.
